summary: One line of dialogue as a ScriptableObject: speaker, portrait, text, and either a next node or choices.
overview: A scene-independent asset holding one line, chained into a conversation by pointing nextNode at the following line or by listing choices. Same relationship to DialogueRunner that VisualStateMachineAsset has to its runner: the tree is data, editable without touching code or a scene.
useCases: Authoring a whole conversation as assets a writer can edit without opening a scene.
Reusing a shared line (a shopkeeper greeting) from several branches.
Version-controlling dialogue as individual files so two people can edit different branches.

gotchas.title: Choices take precedence over nextNode
gotchas.body: If a node has any choices, nextNode is not used. Leaving a stale nextNode on a branching node is harmless but misleading to read.

gotchas.title: Nothing detects a cycle
gotchas.body: Pointing a node back at an earlier one is legal and useful for a loop, but a branch with no exit will never end the conversation.
